name: Video Explainer Tutorial
description: Turns knowledge points, procedure steps, or product usage into a segmented explainer tutorial video.

planning.planning_notes: Expand the teaching sections from the steps or topic the user gives; each section maps to a visual and a video clip.
planning.prompt_guide: Accurate content, clear steps, and visuals that match the narration one to one. Never invent product features the user did not provide.
conduct_rules: Decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user's goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Pass the tutorial plan copy to every step image with prompt_for so the images consume the upstream content; dependency_for only sets ordering and cannot replace content input
Generate and confirm a dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user's goal and the workflow can run
Core flow is complete; minor non-critical adjustments allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user's goal and keep input assets consistent
